info.title: Yojana Mitra API
info.description:
Public tools (no auth) and the token-protected Admin API used by the separate admin panel.

**Admin auth**: send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where token is an API key (`ym_…`, created with `pnpm --filter @ym/api admin:key`) or a 15-minute JWT obtained from `POST /admin/v1/auth/token`. Scopes: `read`, `write`, `review`.

**Review model**: every created or edited scheme, rule version or translation is `pending` until a principal with the `review` scope approves it. Only approved content is ever shown to users.
